bear_assumptions: USD 9.00 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 22x; growth normalizes sharply, gross margin approaches 70%, and customer-credit, supply and guarantee exposure compresses the justified multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 11.50 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 27x; fiscal Q3 guidance converts, Rubin extends platform growth, and infrastructure financing plus customer concentration cap the multiple.
bull_assumptions: USD 14.00 forward normalized EPS including stock compensation at 32x; broad inference and physical-AI demand, strong Rubin execution and durable platform rents outweigh financing and export risk.
rating_change_conditions: Downgrade if normalized earnings fall below the bear path, gross margin remains below 70%, guarantees or receivables produce material losses, Rubin misses its cycle, export controls intensify, or platform attachment weakens; upgrade confidence only after commitments convert without credit loss and customer concentration declines.
